payload.exhibitionTitle: Fleeting Worlds: Nature in Japanese Prints and Botanical Studies
payload.curatorialRationale: This exhibition creates a dialogue between Eastern and Western traditions of observing the natural world. Centered on Japanese woodblock prints (ukiyo-e) and complemented by European and Chinese botanical studies, the selection explores transient moments in nature—from crashing waves to delicate blossoms. The salon-style arrangement encourages intimate viewing and highlights the intricate details and shared medium of ink on paper. All works are light-sensitive and adhere to the 50 lux requirement, ensuring their preservation while offering a cohesive visual experience on a single gallery wall.
